title.narrative: Supporting Youth-Friendly Education and Awareness Raising on Sexual and Reproductive Health (SRH) and Gender Based Violence Prevention
Supporting Youth-Friendly Education and Awareness Raising on Sexual and Reproductive Health (SRH) and Gender Based Violence Prevention

description.narrative:
The Republic of Moldova faces significant challenges in sexual health, including rising rates of HIV, other sexually transmitted infections (STIs), unplanned teenage pregnancies, and sexual violence. This project aims to promote comprehensive SRH education, raise awareness, reduce stigma, and ultimately improve sexual health outcomes among youth in the Republic of Moldova. Youth in Moldova exhibit a lack of comprehensive knowledge about sexuality, contributing to these issues. For instance, there are 22 teenage births per 1,000 women aged 15 to 19 in Moldova, compared to an EU average of 8.9. Nearly half of sexually active young people report not using any contraceptive method during their last sexual encounter. Additionally, social attitudes in Moldova reflect persistent stereotypes and unequal gender roles, further exacerbating these problems. This project aims to address the gaps in sexual and reproductive health (SRH) education and awareness among youth by promoting comprehensive SRH education, improving access to youth-friendly SRH services, and addressing stigma and misinformation surrounding sexuality and STIs.
The project will develop a program to educate and inform teens and key influences on SRH and STI's. The main beneficiaries will be 1600 youth and 300 parents that will be trained on SRH. The partner will also train youth leaders, peer counsellors and librarians to conduct trainings and provide information on SRH and the use of referral channels for specialized support. Additionally, there will also be PR activities and a campaign to raise awareness among the wider public.
